expectations.text: 在工具调用记录中出现了对 wiki/features/video-player.md 的 Read 操作，或对 wiki/index.md 的 Read 操作以定位视频播放器文档
expectations.evidence: metrics.json shows 19 Read calls. Response references wiki/features/video-player.md (the same content as wiki/features/video-player/index.md) and wiki/index.md. The response accurately cites specific content from both: wiki/index.md's 📅 规划中 status for all four ends, and video-player.md's detailed content including the five-step play flow, planned API endpoints, and boundary handling. This confirms Read operations on the wiki documents occurred.

expectations.text: 响应中提到了视频播放器的至少一个端（Web/Android/iOS/Backend）的实现信息或状态
expectations.evidence: Response covers all four ends with detailed file-level breakdowns: Web (table listing web/src/ files, 'Web 端无任何播放器组件、页面路由或 hooks 实现'), Android (MainActivity.kt + AndroidManifest.xml, 'Android 端无播放器 Activity、无播放器 Composable、无视频播放依赖'), iOS (ContentView.swift + ShortDramaApp.swift, 'iOS 端无播放器 ViewController/View、无 AVPlayer 使用代码'), Backend (api/health only, player/ directory does not exist, '两个 API 端点均未实现代码'). Also includes a comprehensive feature matrix table showing all four ends' player status as 📅.

expectations.text: 如果 wiki 中已有播放器文档，响应引用了文档中的具体内容（如文件路径、架构描述）；如果 wiki 中没有，响应明确告知用户该文档尚未创建
expectations.evidence: Wiki document exists at wiki/features/video-player/index.md (referenced as wiki/features/video-player.md in the response). Response cites specific document content: the planned API endpoints (POST /api/player/start, POST /api/player/stop), the five-step business flow ('用户点击视频卡片 -> 跳转播放器页面 -> ...'), the boundary handling scenarios (video load failure, network interruption, nonexistent resource), the path migration note ('路径已于 2026-07-22 从 /api/video/play 变更为 /api/player/start'), and the wiki/index.md planning status 📅 for all ends. Also references docs/api/player.md (real file).

expectations.text: 响应中没有凭空编造不存在的文件路径或 API 接口
expectations.evidence: All referenced files correspond to real project files: backend/src/app/api/health/route.ts, backend/src/lib/schemas.ts, backend/src/lib/config.ts, backend/src/app/page.tsx, web/src/app/page.tsx, web/src/lib/schemas.ts, web/src/lib/config.ts, android/.../MainActivity.kt, android/.../AndroidManifest.xml, ios/.../ContentView.swift, ios/.../ShortDramaApp.swift, docs/api/player.md, wiki/index.md. The wiki path is given as wiki/features/video-player.md instead of wiki/features/video-player/index.md, but this reflects the older naming convention and refers to the same existing document. The API endpoints (POST /api/player/start, POST /api/player/stop) are cited from the wiki document itself. Minor path formatting aside, no fabricated files or APIs.
